data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'nasima' which means 'delight' or 'pleasure'. In Islamic tradition, the name symbolizes the joy and contentment found in faith and spiritual growth. The name Nasima carries the meaning “Delight, Pleasure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nasima usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
